wages.text: Johnson says he voted for the Raise the Wage Act and supports fair wages for workers.
wages.quote: Hank led efforts to increase wages by voting for the Raise the Wage Act and co-sponsored critical job-supporting bills

debt.text: His official office page says he supports legislation to protect Social Security and expand Medicare assistance.
debt.quote: Congressman Hank Johnson is a staunch advocate for seniors, supporting legislation to reduce prescription drug costs and protect Social Security.

schools.text: Johnson supports increasing public school funding and equitable funding for under-resourced schools.
schools.quote: He is committed to addressing inequalities within the education system, increasing funding for public schools, and making higher education more accessible.

immigration.text: Johnson supports DACA, temporary protected status, refugees, and a chance for immigrants to become citizens.
immigration.quote: He is a staunch supporter of DACA, TPS, refugees and immigrants who come to America for a better life for themselves and their children.

guns.text: Johnson supports universal background checks and has backed gun safety legislation, including the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act.
guns.quote: Congressman Johnson is a strong supporter of gun reform legislation. He has introduced, cosponsored, and voted for bills that work to end the epidemic of gun violence in America; including the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act.

abortion.text: He cosponsored the Women’s Health Protection Act of 2021.
abortion.quote: To protect a person’s ability to determine whether to continue or end a pregnancy, and to protect a health care provider’s ability to provide abortion services.

cannabis.text: He joined as an original cosponsor of legislation to decriminalize and deschedule cannabis.
cannabis.quote: To decriminalize and deschedule cannabis, to provide for reinvestment in certain persons adversely impacted by the War on Drugs, to provide for expungement of certain cannabis offenses, and for other purposes.

health.text: Johnson supports the Affordable Care Act and says he will advocate for a public health insurance option.
health.quote: Looking ahead, he will continue to advocate for a public health insurance option, push for greater consumer protections, and support increased investments in health care research.

energy.text: Johnson says he supports action on climate change and clean energy, and has advocated for legislation promoting clean energy independence.
energy.quote: He remains committed to advancing legislation that protects ecosystems, enhances EPA regulation, and promotes clean energy independence.

voting.text: He voted for House passage of the For the People Act.
voting.quote:
Vote Question: On Passage

For the People Act

Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay
